mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in the prior month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations decline, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down > 0.5% MoM) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO < 108.0), S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to heightened inflationary pressures and reduced corporate output, with the effect most pronounced during early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO falls below 108.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signals reduced residential investment, acting as a leading indicator of slowing economic growth that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST falls below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate above 3.9% and decline in nonfarm payrolls below 150,000 thousand signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE > 3.9% and PAYEMS < 150000 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.
